post.description: Creates the initial currency configuration for the specified company. The supplied `currency_iso_code` becomes the company's base currency. Setting `multicurrency_enabled=true` requires a signed multicurrency beta agreement, otherwise the API returns 400 MISSING_BETA_AGREEMENT. Returns the created configuration wrapped under a `data` key (V2 convention).

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: String ID of the Procore company for which to create the currency configuration. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies (cast to string).

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company's base currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'). Required. Determines the default currency for all company-level financial objects. Cannot be changed via the v1 PATCH endpoint, so choose carefully.

currency_display.description: How currency amounts should be rendered. 'symbol' renders with the locale currency glyph (e.g., $); 'code' renders with the ISO code (e.g., USD). Omit to leave unset.

multicurrency_enabled.description: Whether to enable multicurrency for the company on creation. When true, projects under this company may be configured with their own currency and exchange rates; requires a signed multicurrency beta agreement, otherwise the API returns 400 MISSING_BETA_AGREEMENT.

schema.title: Company Currency Configuration V2 Response
schema.description: V2 response wrapper for a created Company Currency Configuration. The newly persisted configuration is nested under `data`. The `company_id` is returned as a string (V2 ID convention).

company_id.description: String identifier of the Procore company this configuration belongs to. Matches the {company_id} path parameter (V2 returns IDs as strings).

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the company's base currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'). All company-scoped monetary amounts in Procore are denominated in this currency.

currency_display.description: How currency amounts should be rendered. 'symbol' renders with the locale currency glyph (e.g., $); 'code' renders with the ISO code (e.g., USD). Returned as null when not specified in the create request.

multicurrency_enabled.description: Whether multicurrency support is enabled for the company at the time of creation. Returned as null when not specified in the create request (treated as false until explicitly enabled).

multicurrency_enabled_effective_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when multicurrency was first enabled for the company. Null when multicurrency was not enabled in the create request.

get.description: Returns the currency configuration for the specified company. When no configuration has been created yet, currency-related fields are returned as null while company eligibility and toggle defaults are still populated, so consumers can detect the unconfigured state without a 404.

schema.title: Company Currency Configuration GET Response
schema.description: Currency configuration for a Procore company. When no configuration has been created yet, currency-related fields are returned as null while company eligibility and toggle defaults are still populated.

company_id.description: Procore company ID this configuration belongs to. Matches the {company_id} path parameter and is the foreign key to use for all company-scoped multicurrency requests.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the company's base currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'). All company-scoped monetary amounts in Procore are denominated in this currency. Null when no currency configuration has been created for the company.

currency_display.description: How currency amounts should be rendered. 'symbol' renders with the locale currency glyph (e.g., $); 'code' renders with the ISO code (e.g., USD). Null when no currency configuration has been created for the company.

multicurrency_enabled.description: Whether multicurrency support is enabled for the company. When true, projects under this company may be configured with their own currency and exchange rates. Returns false (and effective date null) when no configuration exists or multicurrency has not been enabled.

multicurrency_enabled_effective_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when multicurrency was first enabled for the company. Null if multicurrency has never been enabled or no currency configuration exists. Use to audit when multicurrency went live.

eligible_for_multicurrency.description: Whether the company satisfies the prerequisites to enable multicurrency (e.g., compatible ERP integration). When false, attempts to enable multicurrency will be rejected; use this to decide whether to surface the multicurrency toggle in your UI.

multicurrency_phase_two_flag_enabled.description: Whether the company has access to the extended multicurrency capabilities (separate base/quote currency tracking and per-record exchange rate fields used by multicurrency-aware downstream resources). When false, the company is limited to baseline multicurrency behavior. Use as a hint when deciding which API shape to expect from other multicurrency-aware endpoints.
